results: Explicit demo selection reuses three ProductCards with semantic heading levels, exact prices and local dimensioned images
desktop: 3 grid columns with no horizontal overflow
tablet: 2 grid columns with no horizontal overflow
mobile: 1 grid columns with no horizontal overflow

Existing card behaviour preserves long titles, deliberate image placeholders, absent comparison prices and low-stock labels

Cards and the demo selection form work without JavaScript
